reviews.t: Works great and lasts all day!

claims.text: Many reviewers find the product effective at tightening skin and reducing wrinkles, often comparing it favorably to pricier brands.
Reviewers frequently praise the value and low price compared to expensive competitors.
Several reviewers note the product can leave a white residue or cakey look and requires a moisturizer.
Some reviewers report the effect does not last all day or that it peels or cracks.
A few reviewers mention a strong or harsh smell, though others found the fragrance pleasant.
